# Underscore · Release 1.13.7

_prod · July 24, 2024 · Changes since 1.13.6_

---

The documentation now offers a dark theme and direct links to function source code.

### 🚀 New Features

- Added a dark theme toggle to the documentation.

### ✨ Improvements

- Added links to the source code for each documented function.

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Corrected the documentation for the step argument of range.

### ⚙️ Technical

- Improved detection of DataView objects when the built-in implementation has been replaced.
